verdict.rationale: The pack shows Supabase auto-generates REST/GraphQL APIs and exposes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (supabase-probe-3) plus agent-oriented llms.txt resources, but nothing describes an interactive, browsable API reference UI with runnable/'try it out' code examples for exploring the API. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive docs/playground page, runnable example execution, or any first-party/independent mention of such a reference tool.
